question: Should Discord Activity support be rebuilt under Canvas/Discord plugin-owned contracts with fail-closed Activity auth, continued through the newer overlapping branch after repair, or paused?
rationale: The unresolved choice crosses plugin ownership, Gateway authorization, token transport, operator config shape, resource limits, and overlapping branches, so automation can identify defects but should not choose the permanent Activity security boundary.

options.title: Rebuild under plugin auth
options.body: Port Activity routing/config to extensions/canvas and extensions/discord, require explicit Activity credentials, avoid URL tokens, bound fanout, and add live proof before merge.

options.title: Continue through the newer branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65205 only after its security, compatibility, proof, and merge-state blockers are resolved.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave Discord Activities out until maintainers settle whether the security model belongs in the Canvas plugin, Discord plugin, or an external package.

recommendation.title: Rebuild under plugin auth
recommendation.body: Port Activity routing/config to extensions/canvas and extensions/discord, require explicit Activity credentials, avoid URL tokens, bound fanout, and add live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main Canvas plugin route ownership and config migration history most directly define the boundary this PR needs to target.
